label: Explanatory circularity: For one bearer, Form and quality, its F-exemplification grounds…
definition: For one bearer, Form and quality, its F-exemplification grounds participation and its participation grounds F-exemplification. These are two actual asserted edges, not the two implications of an iff or an epistemic way of discovering either fact.
note: Modern analytical test vocabulary for issue #260. The primary passages motivate the question, not these formal definitions. A sourced replacement would require a passage specifying these precise relations and restrictions.
